tools.name: pdfco_get_credit_balance
tools.description: Get the remaining PDF.co credits and plan info for the account. Every processing call uses credits, so check this first when a call fails for lack of credits. PDF.co API: GET /v1/account/credit/balance.

tools.name: pdfco_get_pdf_info
tools.description: Read a PDF's metadata: page count, page sizes, encryption and form flags. Reads the file only; it does not change it. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/info.

tools.name: pdfco_find_text
tools.description: Search a PDF for a text string or regular expression and return where it matches (page and position). Reads the file only. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/find.

tools.name: pdfco_list_parser_templates
tools.description: List the saved document parser templates on the account. Use a template id with pdfco_parse_document. PDF.co API: GET /v1/pdf/documentparser/templates.

tools.name: pdfco_parse_document
tools.description: Extract fields from a document (for example an invoice) with a saved parser template and return them as JSON, YAML, XML or CSV. Reads the file only. Find template ids with pdfco_list_parser_templates. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/documentparser.

tools.name: pdfco_pdf_to_text
tools.description: Extract the text of a PDF into a text file (OCR runs on scanned pages). Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Reads the file only. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/convert/to/text.

tools.name: pdfco_pdf_to_csv
tools.description: Convert the tables in a PDF to a CSV file. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Reads the file only. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/convert/to/csv.

tools.name: pdfco_merge_pdfs
tools.description: Merge 2 to 20 public PDF URLs into one PDF, in the order given. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/merge.

tools.name: pdfco_split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF so that only the given pages stay in the output. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/split.

tools.name: pdfco_compress_pdf
tools.description: Make a smaller copy of a PDF. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v2/pdf/compress.

tools.name: pdfco_add_pdf_password
tools.description: Make an encrypted copy of a PDF with an owner password and a user (open) password. The source file is not changed. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/security/add.

tools.name: pdfco_remove_pdf_password
tools.description: Make an unprotected copy of a password-protected PDF. The source file is not changed. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/security/remove.

tools.name: pdfco_url_to_pdf
tools.description: Render a public web page to a PDF. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/convert/from/url.

tools.name: pdfco_markdown_to_pdf
tools.description: Render Markdown text to a PDF. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/convert/from/md.

tools.name: pdfco_excel_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert one worksheet of an Excel file (XLS or XLSX) to a PDF. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/xls/convert/to/pdf.

tools.name: pdfco_make_searchable
tools.description: Add a searchable text layer (OCR) to a scanned PDF. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/makesearchable.

tools.name: pdfco_delete_pages
tools.description: Make a copy of a PDF without the given pages. The source file is not changed. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/edit/delete-pages.

tools.name: pdfco_rotate_pages
tools.description: Make a copy of a PDF with the given pages rotated. The source file is not changed. Returns a `url` to the output file on PDF.co temporary storage (deleted after about 60 minutes). Uses credits. PDF.co API: POST /v1/pdf/edit/rotate.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pdfco_get_pdf_info, pdfco_find_text, pdfco_add_pdf_password · Private data: pdfco_get_pdf_info, pdfco_find_text, pdfco_list_parser_templates, pdfco_parse_document, pdfco_pdf_to_text, pdfco_pdf_to_csv, pdfco_merge_pdfs, pdfco_split_pdf, pdfco_compress_pdf, pdfco_add_pdf_password, pdfco_remove_pdf_password, pdfco_url_to_pdf, pdfco_markdown_to_pdf, pdfco_excel_to_pdf, pdfco_make_searchable, pdfco_delete_pages, pdfco_rotate_pages · Public sink: pdfco_get_pdf_info, pdfco_find_text, pdfco_parse_document, pdfco_pdf_to_text, pdfco_pdf_to_csv, pdfco_merge_pdfs, pdfco_split_pdf, pdfco_compress_pdf, pdfco_add_pdf_password, pdfco_remove_pdf_password, pdfco_url_to_pdf, pdfco_markdown_to_pdf, pdfco_excel_to_pdf, pdfco_make_searchable, pdfco_delete_pages, pdfco_rotate_pages · Destructive: pdfco_remove_pdf_password, pdfco_delete_pages.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pdfco_get_pdf_info, pdfco_find_text, pdfco_add_pdf_password · Private data: pdfco_get_pdf_info, pdfco_find_text, pdfco_list_parser_templates, pdfco_parse_document, pdfco_pdf_to_text, pdfco_pdf_to_csv, pdfco_merge_pdfs, pdfco_split_pdf, pdfco_compress_pdf, pdfco_add_pdf_password, pdfco_remove_pdf_password, pdfco_url_to_pdf, pdfco_markdown_to_pdf, pdfco_excel_to_pdf, pdfco_make_searchable, pdfco_delete_pages, pdfco_rotate_pages · Public sink: pdfco_get_pdf_info, pdfco_find_text, pdfco_parse_document, pdfco_pdf_to_text, pdfco_pdf_to_csv, pdfco_merge_pdfs, pdfco_split_pdf, pdfco_compress_pdf, pdfco_add_pdf_password, pdfco_remove_pdf_password, pdfco_url_to_pdf, pdfco_markdown_to_pdf, pdfco_excel_to_pdf, pdfco_make_searchable, pdfco_delete_pages, pdfco_rotate_pages · Destructive: pdfco_remove_pdf_password, pdfco_delete_pages

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
